<thought>Search for templates that form sulfonamides from amine and acyl chloride.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["primary amines", "acyl chloride"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>

Let's try.
